title: Pay point of consumption tax on wagering
what: Pay point of consumption tax on net wagering revenue above $150,000 a financial year.

sources.title: Gaming Control Act 1993 (Tas)
sources.quote: A betting operator is liable to pay the following tax on the betting operator’s net wagering revenue for a financial year: (a) if the net wagering revenue for the financial year is $150 000 or less, no tax is payable; (b) if the net wagering revenue for the financial year is more than $150 000, tax is payable at the rate of 15% of the amount by which the net wagering revenue exceeds $150 000
